We found only one case for which a gene family was represented in a genome only by a pseudogene. *Parnips nigripes* contains a PL1\_8-like region whose tblastn hits fell below the 45% identity threshold, which was characterized separately by protein-to-genome alignment of two cynipid PL1\_8 proteins (*Aulacidea tavakolii* and *Ceroptres masudai*) with miniprot v0.9 and exonerate v2.4.0 (protein2genome), followed by a dbCAN-sub hmmsearch of the translated alignment.
